value.name: CorporateIncomeTax
value.description:
**

Corporate income tax endpoints includes endpoints to get current prepayment information, calculate prepayment with given values and sending actual prepayment application. 

Typical usage of these endpoints is that current prepayment information in retrieved first and then trial calculation is done with new values if necessary. Then actual prepayment application is sent to Tax Administration using SendPrepaymentApplication endpoint. The application is typically processed right after it has been sent and result can be retrieved with GetPrepaymentInfo in about 60 seconds. Current information will reflect the application if the prepayment application was accepted and has been successfully processed. Prepayment decision letter pdf can be retrieved using Decisions and Letters API endpoints (ListLetters, GetLetter)

value.name: DecisionsAndLetters
value.description:
**

Summary

Decisions and letters API contains endpoints to handle letters, decisions and information requests of business customers. Endpoints cannot be used to access letters of individuals or private traders. 

Typical usage of these endpoint is that first letters or info requests are listed using ListLetters or ListInfoRequests endpoints. These endpoints provide letter numbers to be used with GetLetter that retrieves the actual letter as pdf file. If letter was an info request then SendInfoRequestResponse and SendInfoRequestAttachment endpoints can be used to send response to the info request letter. 

List of all letter types used in endpoint and their names in Finnish, English and Swedish can be retrieved with the Codes API.

value.name: EMCS
value.description:
**

Overview

Excise Movement and Control System (EMCS) API functions provide endpoints for customer systems to send and receive EMCS related filings, reports and other messages from and to Tax Administration. EMCS APIs are designed to be used with Notification Service APIs. Notification service provides notifications for customer system that there is EMCS related messages that need attention. The notification contains key values that can be then used to get EMCS related message content from endpoints under EMCS API services. See more details about the notification service in the Tax Administration API portal.

Please note

  • When calling services behalf of third party, then valid Suomi.fi authorization is required with one of the following authorization roles: 
    • Veroasioiden hoito
    • Valmisteveroasioiden hoito
    • Valmisteveronalaisten tuotteiden siirtojen ilmoittaminen
  • Suomi.fi authorization can take about 500 - 1500 milliseconds

Typical use case scenarios

A) Setting up with API services

  1. Verify connectivity with Vero API services by acquiring a test certificate for development, see general guidance (vero.fi).
  2. Use Notification Service API endpoints to subscribe all EMCS related notification types. Develop support for notification subscription management to your application.
  3. Develop your application to poll notification service with the subscription id and build proper orchestration for ECMS related API service calls that fits your application's use cases.

B) Day to day operations with EMCS APIs

API usage scenario 1: Sending goods to other member state

  1. Send draft eAD IE815 with FileEADDraft endpoint to Tax Administration. IE815 is validated in real time and if validations are passed, the service responds with accepted time stamp (AcceptedTimestamp), unique EMCS resource indicator (URI) and unique identifier of the service call (UniqueIdentifier).
  2. Get your valid eAD IE801 by calling GetEAD endpoint with the URI value that was received in the FileEADDraft response message.
  3. You will receive also a notification about IE801 if you have subscribed EMCSIE801 notification type. Poll notification service's ListNotifications endpoint with proper timeframe and EMCSIE801 notification is returned with URI value about your IE815 filing.
  4. Send your goods
  5. Poll notification service regularly and you'll receive notifications about events related to your eAD. Expected notification is EMCSIE818 Report of Receipt.
  6. When EMCSIE818 notification type is received, call GetReportOfReceipt endpoint to get the data with the URI that was included in the notification message.

API usage scenario 2: Receiving goods from other member state

  1. Poll notification service's ListNotifications endpoint regularly with proper timeframe parameters. EMCSIE801 notification is returned with URI value about the shipment that was sent to you.
  2. Call GetEAD endpoint to get IE801 with the URI you received from the notification service.
  3. Receive your goods
  4. Send Report of Receipt IE818 using FileReportOfReceipt endpoint.

Common technical details

Each request message structure and content will be validated, summary of typical responses:

  • 200 - OK if all validations are passed. When submitting returns or reports 200 - OK response containing a unique identifier and an accepted timestamp confirms that Finnish Tax Administration has received the information.
  • 400 - Bad Request with error code and message from the service. Caller must review and correct the input and send it again. Common error codes:
    • 1005 - Error in json structure or invalid value in a field
    • 1040 - Caller does not have access to the data - check if Suomi.fi authorization is required
  • 500 - Internal Server Error, client certificate of the caller might not yet been set up or temporary issue or outage in the system, endpoint can be called again later.

More information about EMCS at Vero.fi:

  • EMCS-järjestelmä (vero.fi)

value.name: SelfAssessedTaxes
value.description:
**

Self-assessed Taxes contain endpoints for for filing VAT return, filing EC sales list, getting filed VAT return and checking a chosen year's VAT periods.

Typical usage of VAT endpoints would be first getting the VAT periods with GetVATPeriods, which returns the filing periods and statuses of returns. These filing periods can be used in the FileVATReturn endpoint. When the filed return has been processed the VAT return can be retrieved using GetFiledVATReturn and corrected when needed by using FileVATReturn again. The returns are generally processed the next business day. 

General SAT information at Vero.fi: Self-assessed taxes - vero.fi
